revenue_source: Tofler company page (updated 21 Nov 2026) shows only a revenue band, not an audited figure: operating revenue range INR 100-500 cr for FY ending 31 Mar 2026 and a key-metrics band of INR 200-300 cr for Mar 2026; exact audited sales figures are behind Tofler Pro paywall. No audited accounts or MCA filing figures publicly readable, so both years left null.
note: Legal entity confirmed and active. CIN U33110GJ2009PTC056957 is stated in the footer of the company's own website (accumaxlab.com/contact-us: 'Accumax Lab Devices Pvt Ltd CIN: U33110GJ2009PTC056957') and independently matched on Tofler (same CIN, incorporated 15 May 2009, status Active, registered office Plot No. 228/1/4, Dantali Industrial Estate, Dantali, Kalol, Gujarat - 382725; authorised capital INR 16.00 cr, paid-up INR 11.05 cr; last AGM 08 Jul 2026; 8 directors incl. Bhupendra Shah, Tejas Shah, Chirag Shah). State: registered in Gujarat (Kalol/Gandhinagar district); input did not state a state, so no mismatch to report. Role: manufacturer - the company's own site lists three own manufacturing units (GIDC Electronic Park SEZ Gandhinagar; Medha, Kadi, Mehsana; gamma sterilisation facility at Devine Industrial Park, Laxmanpura) and Tofler classifies it as 'Manufacturing of Machinery & Equipments' / manufacturer of liquid handling equipment. PAN: not published on any accessible public page - zaubacorp, thecompanycheck and instafinancials returned HTTP 403/404, and search backends (DuckDuckGo via searx, Google) were unavailable or returned no usable results, so PAN and its 4th-character holder type are null rather than inferred. GSTIN and GST status: no public GST profile could be retrieved for the same reason - null, not confirmed. Revenue: only paywalled bands available (see revenue_source), so FY25 and FY26 are null per the no-invention rule. Declared HS 842119/842199/903180 (centrifuges/filters/measuring instruments) is broadly consistent with a lab liquid-handling and benchtop-equipment maker, but HS verification is outside this registry-only scope and is not a rejection ground in any case. No ground for rejection: entity exists and is Active, not struck off, liquidated or bankrupt.
